apps.name: RA Companion
apps.subtitle: Companion app for RetroAchievements
apps.localizedDescription:
Track your RetroAchievements progress directly from your iPhone.

Features:
• Live progression tracking
• Recent unlocks and badges
• Game library overview

versions.localizedDescription:
Import your own skins in the settings, then export or delete them. Export, import or reset your settings, delete your personal notes, and back up everything (settings, theme, skins and notes) in one file. On iPhone, files are now chosen and saved with the Files app. The scroll bar of the lists no longer fights with the swipe, and the notes import refuses a file that is not a notes file. On Windows and Linux, the port of the OBS overlay can be changed in the settings.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v2.4...v2.5

The game card shows the average time to 100% and a summary of your session. The game search has two new tabs, Recent and Want to Play, each with a search field. Tap your avatar, the game picture or an achievement badge to open its RetroAchievements page. New on Windows and Linux: an overlay for OBS, and long lists that show up at once.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v2.3...v2.4

The color of a pressed button is more visible on the Dark, Light, Light Paper and Kirby themes. On Windows, the title bar takes the colors of the theme. On Windows and Linux, all themes now share the shapes of the default theme.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v2.2...v2.3

New Kirby skin. On a wide window the Windows app now shows two columns, and a button folds the profile and game cards. The rank wraps under the name when the screen is narrow, and the Achievements tab shrinks its text instead of being cut.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v2.1...v2.2

AI translation: add one or several AI services (Gemini, Groq, Mistral, OpenAI, Ollama...) with automatic fallback, and choose the order of all translation services. New button to clear the translation cache. The settings windows adapt their height to their content. On Windows, the main window remembers its position and size.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v2.0...v2.1

Translation is faster and more reliable (services that fail are skipped for a while, automatic retries, cache). Web links in comments are highlighted and clickable. Cut / Copy / Paste bar on a long press on Android and iOS, right-click edit menu on Windows.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.9...v2.0

Hint under the update button, Buy Me a Coffee link in the settings.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.8...v1.9

LibreTranslate: option to accept an invalid certificate for your own server, and a Test button (Windows, Android, iOS) that checks each translation service and shows which one really answers. Resizable personal notes area on Windows (corner handle).

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.7...v1.8

Translation services: DeepL and LibreTranslate (key / server in the settings) with a preferred service, the others take over if one fails. Windows: global refresh shortcut that works while an emulator has the focus (Ctrl+Alt+R by default), windows open on the screen of the app.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.6...v1.7

Refresh interval down to 5 s, configurable refresh shortcut on Windows (F1 by default).

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.5...v1.6

In-app unlock banner on iOS and Android: badge, description, points, stacking, auto height. Automatic retries on temporary API errors, readable error messages on Windows.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.4...v1.5

First iOS version: margins for the notch and the home indicator, in-app banner when an achievement unlocks, system notifications when the app has just been sent to the background, native clipboard and automatic detection of the device language. Two new sort orders by the hardcore median time needed to unlock each achievement.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.3...v1.4
